title: Beer Gardens and a Taste of Home in Munich
description: Munich delivered the kind of summer day best measured in beer-garden tables and good food. I was surprised by how many Chinese restaurants there were and finally got a taste of the food I had been missing.
coverAlt: Partly finished Hofbräu beer in a large glass mug on a sunlit Munich beer-garden table
